It looks like the elves are using Christmas spirit to turn treats into killing soldiers!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 5 ([[Cold Ambush]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gingerbread''' was an enemy that exclusively appeared in [[Cold Ambush]] as part of the [[Violent Night Event]]. It had higher health than all enemies that appeared before it, but it was slower than them. ==Appearance== The '''Gingerbread''' was a toasted brown humanoid gingerbread man. It had a cylindrical head with a smiling face made and three white icing dots which resembled buttons on the front of its torso both made from white icing. It wobbled as it walked. ==Strategy== *Early game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Cowboy]], [[Golden Cowboy]], [[Militant]] or [[Crook Boss]] can do quite well against these. *As these enemies spawn in large numbers, towers that can damage multiple enemies at once, such as the [[Executioner]], [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] can be useful against this. *Later on during the game, stronger towers like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Minigunner]] can kill the '''Gingerbread''' quite easily. ==Trivia== *The '''Gingerbread''' used the [https://www.roblox.com/catalog/42588770 Gingerbread Man Head] as its head ==Update History== *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Gingerbread''' added. *'''4 February 2023''' - [[v1.6.1]] **'''Gingerbread''' removed. {{ColdAmbush|[[Speedy Elf (Cold Ambush)|Speedy Elf]]|Wave 3|Gingerbread|Wave 5|[[Snowman (Cold Ambush)|Snowman]]|Wave 7}} {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Gingerbread}}
